column1: # mapping_set_description: Term correspondences from the canonical DataCite 4.7 linked-data vocabulary to
#   Schema.org 30.1. Contextual conversion rules and exhaustive source-term review outcomes are maintained separately
# comment: 'Canonical flat property IRIs identify terms; XML context is recorded in conversion rules. closeMatch,
#   broadMatch and narrowMatch state how closely the meanings correspond; relatedMatch records an association only.
#   No exact matches are asserted, and no mapping authorizes record conversion without the conversion rules.
#   The rules are declarative documentation, not an executable or lossless converter. Coverage completeness means
#   all 253 source terms received an explicit review outcome, not that every term has a target equivalent.'
